Class ManagerTrendController

java.lang.Object
ManagerTrendController
public class ManagerTrendController extends Object
Controls the manager trend page. Displays daily sales reports, order statistics, and product usage information.

    • addRecipeUsage

      private void addRecipeUsage(Connection conn, int menuItemID, int quantity, Map<String,Double> salesMap) throws Exception
      Calculates the inventory usage for a sold menu item. Uses the recipe amount and quantity sold to update the total usage map.
      Parameters:
      conn - database connection
      menuItemID - ID of the sold menu item
      quantity - number of the menu item sold
      salesMap - stores the total usage for each inventory item
      Throws:
      Exception - if the SQL query cannot be loaded or executed

    • loadSoldItems

      private void loadSoldItems(Connection conn, LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate, Map<Integer,Integer> salesMap) throws Exception
      Loads all menu items sold within the selected date range. Adds the quantities of repeated menu items together in the sales map.
      Parameters:
      conn - database connection
      startDate - start date of the selected report range
      endDate - end date of the selected report range
      salesMap - stores each menu item ID and its total quantity sold
      Throws:
      Exception - if the SQL query cannot be loaded or executed

    • generateProductUsage

      private void generateProductUsage()
      Generates a product usage report for the selected date range. Calculates inventory usage from sold menu items and displays the results in the chart, general report, summary, and details text sections.

    • loadMenuNames

      private void loadMenuNames(Connection conn, Map<Integer,String> menuNames) throws Exception
      Loads menu item names from the database. Maps each menu item ID to its corresponding menu item name.
      Parameters:
      conn - database connection
      menuNames - stores menu item IDs and their names
      Throws:
      Exception - if the SQL query cannot be loaded or executed

    • generateSalesReport

      private void generateSalesReport()
      Generates a sales report for the selected date range. Groups sales by menu item and displays the quantity sold for each item along with the best-selling item and report summary.
